issues.failure_explanation: In (3.5), the term $L_4$ involves the one-sided trace $(\tilde{I} - \Lambda\tilde{I})^-$ on interior faces. The DG norm defined in Section 2.2 only contains the jump $\llbracket \cdot \rrbracket$ across interior faces, not the one-sided trace. Applying Cauchy-Schwarz bounds $L_4$ by the $L^2$ norm of the one-sided trace $(\tilde{I} - \Lambda\tilde{I})^-$, which is not controlled by $\|\tilde{I} - \Lambda\tilde{I}\|_{DG}$ alone (for example, if $\tilde{I} - \Lambda\tilde{I}$ has jump zero across a face, the DG norm on that face vanishes while its trace does not).
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Replace $\|\cdot\|_{DG}$ for $\tilde{I} - \Lambda\tilde{I}$ in Lemma 3.2 with an extended DG norm that includes the element face traces (standard in discontinuous Galerkin analysis), and note that the local projection error estimate in Lemma 3.1 already controls these boundary face traces at rate $O(h^{k+1/2})$.
issues.overall_effect: The continuity estimate (3.4) of the bilinear form for $\tilde{I} - \Lambda\tilde{I}$ under the standard DG norm is unproven and formally invalid as stated, which affects the step in (3.19) of Theorem 3.1.
issues.title: Invalid inference bounding one-sided interior face trace by DG jump norm
issues.why_classification: Introducing the standard extended DG norm containing face traces is a local routine fix that preserves the rate $O(h^{k+1/2})$ and all main claims without requiring new architecture.

issues.failure_explanation: Equation (3.9) claims $\|\tilde{I} - \tilde{I} \circ \Phi_h^{-1}\|_{L^2} \le \|\mathrm{id} - \Phi_h^{-1}\|_{L^\infty} \|\tilde{I}\|_{L^2}$. This inequality is mathematically false for non-constant functions: bounding $\tilde{I}(x) - \tilde{I}(\Phi_h^{-1}(x))$ requires the gradient of $\tilde{I}$, yielding $\|\tilde{I} - \tilde{I} \circ \Phi_h^{-1}\|_{L^2} \lesssim \|\mathrm{id} - \Phi_h^{-1}\|_{L^\infty} \|\nabla \tilde{I}\|_{L^2}$. Furthermore, in (3.11), the gradient contribution $h \|\tilde{I} - I^\dag\|_{H^1}^2 \lesssim h^{2k+1} \|\tilde{I}\|_{H^1}^2$ from (3.10) is omitted and erroneously replaced by $h^{2k+1} \|\tilde{I}\|_{L^2}^2$, resulting in the incorrect statement (3.8) which lacks any $H^1$ norm of $\tilde{I}$.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Replace $\|\tilde{I}\|_{L^2}$ with $\|\tilde{I}\|_{H^1}$ in (3.9), (3.11), and the statement (3.8) of Lemma 3.3. Since Theorem 3.1 assumes $\tilde{I} \in H^{k+1}$ with $k \ge 2$, $\|\tilde{I}\|_{H^1}$ is readily bounded by $\|\tilde{I}\|_{H^{k+1}}$.
issues.overall_effect: The bound in Lemma 3.3 is false as stated without the $H^1$ norm of $\tilde{I}$, rendering the downstream reliance on (3.8) in Theorem 3.1 strictly unsupported as written.
issues.title: Invalid shift estimate bounding function difference by L2 norm instead of H1 norm
issues.why_classification: The repair is a routine correction that adds the required derivative norm to the estimate without affecting the convergence rate or advertised scope of the theorem.

issues.failure_explanation: In (3.25), $D_c$ is defined as the set of mesh elements intersecting the characteristic boundary $\Gamma_h^0$. The proof asserts that $Vol(D_c) \lesssim h^{k+1}$ by citing (3.8). However, (3.8) is Lemma 3.3 and concerns $\|\tilde{I} - I^\dag\|_{DG}$, containing no statement about $Vol(D_c)$. Moreover, in a quasi-uniform mesh of diameter $h$, each mesh element $K \in \mathcal{T}_h$ has volume $\sim h^d$ ($d=2,3$). Since $D_c$ is non-empty, $Vol(D_c) \gtrsim h^d$. For $k \ge 2$, $h^{k+1} \ll h^d$ (for example, in 2D with $k=2$, $Vol(D_c) \sim h^2$, whereas $h^{k+1} = h^3$). The claim $Vol(D_c) \lesssim h^{k+1}$ is therefore mathematically false, yet it is critically used to claim $h^{-1/2} Vol(D_c)^{1/2} \lesssim h^{(k-1)/2}$ and achieve the convergence order $O(h^{k+1/2})$ for $T_3$.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Replace the volume-based estimate of $T_3$ with a contained polynomial inverse/trace inequality argument on the boundary layer patch $\Gamma_h^- \setminus \Phi_h(\Gamma^-)$ of width $O(h^k)$, or use weighted boundary estimates with $|\Omega \cdot \boldsymbol{n}_h|$ to bound $T_3$ without invoking the false element volume estimate $Vol(D_c) \lesssim h^{k+1}$.
issues.overall_effect: The proof of Theorem 3.1 fails to establish the stated $O(h^{k+1/2})$ error bound for the upwind DG method, leaving the bound on the boundary consistency error $T_3$ unestablished.
issues.title: Unsubstantiated and false element volume bound used to estimate inflow boundary mismatch error
issues.why_classification: Repairing the estimate of $T_3$ requires a non-trivial replacement argument using polynomial trace estimates on the small boundary strip, but does not alter the advertised rate or require global proof architecture changes.
